'''''Lavandula pedunculata''''', commonly called '''Spanish Lavender'''<ref>{{Cite web |last=Titchmarsh |first=Alan |date=2015-05-24 |title=Alan Titchmarsh's tips on growing lavender in your garden |url=https://www.express.co.uk/life-style/garden/578835/How-to-grow-lavender |access-date=2024-06-24 |website=Express.co.uk |language=en}}</ref> or '''French lavender''',<ref name=RHS>{{cite web|url=http://apps.rhs.org.uk/plantselector/plant?plantid=1130|title=Royal Horticultural Society Plant Selector|access-date=2012-10-26|archive-date=2012-12-24|archive-url=https://archive.today/20121224043011/http://apps.rhs.org.uk/plantselector/plant?plantid=1130|url-status=dead}}</ref> is a species of [[flowering plant]] in the [[Family (taxonomy)|family]] [[Lamiaceae]]. It is known for the tuft of two or three butterfly-like, narrow petals that emerge from the top of its ovoid head. ''L. pedunculata'' is native to [[Iberian Peninsula|Iberia]], [[Morocco]] and western [[Turkey]].<ref name=RHS />

== Description ==
''L. pedunculata'' is a bushy evergreen shrub with narrow, grey-green, aromatic leaves<ref>{{Cite web |last=Scalera |first=Sally |title=Lavender is a lovely garden addition to try this May |url=https://www.floridatoday.com/story/life/home-garden/spaces/2017/05/12/lavender-lovely-fragrant-garden-addition-try-may/101620976/ |access-date=2024-06-24 |website=Florida Today |language=en-US}}</ref> and small dark-purple flowers in long-stalked, dense heads tipped with large purple bracts.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Lavandula pedunculata subsp. pedunculata {{!}} French lavender Shrubs/RHS Gardening |url=http://www.rhs.org.uk/plants/231665/lavandula-pedunculata-subsp-pedunculata/details |access-date=2024-06-24 |website=www.rhs.org.uk |language=en-gb}}</ref> 

== Subspecies ==
There are five subspecies of ''L. pedunculata'':<ref>{{Cite web|title=Lavandula pedunculata (Mill.) Cav.|url=https://www.gbif.org/species/7307760|access-date=2021-03-15|website=www.gbif.org|language=en}}</ref>

* ''Lavandula pedunculata'' subsp. ''atlantica'' (Braun-Blanq.) Romo
* ''Lavandula pedunculata'' subsp. ''cariensis'' (Boiss.) Upson & S.Andrews
* ''Lavandula pedunculata'' subsp. ''lusitanica'' (Chaytor) Franco
* ''Lavandula pedunculata'' subsp. ''pedunculata''
* ''Lavandula pedunculata'' subsp. ''sampaiana'' (Rozeira) Franco
